description: Dendro is the fourth Element the Traveler acquires by resonating with the Statue of The Seven in Sumeru .
role_summary: Dendro is the fourth Element the Traveler acquires by resonating with the Statue of The Seven in Sumeru .

talents.name: Foreign Fieldcleaver
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Razorgrass Blade
talents.description: With a flourish of your blade, you unleash a spray of razor-sharp leaves that go before you and deal Dendro DMG .

talents.name: Surgent Manifestation
talents.description: Calling upon the might of the flora all around you, you create a Lea Lotus Lamp. This Lamp will deal continuous Dendro DMG to opponents within its AoE. Lotuslight Transfiguration The Lea Lotus Lamp will undergo the following changes after it comes into contact with Hydro / Electro / Pyro : Hydro : the Lamp's AoE and the AoE of its attacks are increased. Electro : the Lamp's ATK SPD is increased. Pyro : the Lamp will explode after a short delay and then disappear, dealing AoE Dendro DMG . The Lea Lotus Lamp can only undergo one Lotuslight Transfiguration in its duration. Only one Lamp created by the Traveler can exist at any one time.

talents.name: Verdant Overgrowth
talents.description: Lea Lotus Lamp will obtain one level of Overflowing Lotuslight every second it is on the field, increasing the Elemental Mastery of active character(s) within its AoE by 6. Overflowing Lotuslight has a maximum of 10 stacks.

talents.name: Verdant Luxury
talents.description: Every point of Elemental Mastery the Traveler possesses increases the DMG dealt by Razorgrass Blade by 0.15% and the DMG dealt by Surgent Manifestation by 0.1%.

talents.name: Foreign Verdalume
talents.description: Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs Additional Buff Effects The Traveler gains an attribute bonus for every element they have resonated with: Anemo : CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, Geo : DEF is increased by 20%, Electro : Energy Recharge is increased by 20%, Dendro : Elemental Mastery is increased by 60, Hydro : HP is increased by 20%, Pyro : ATK is increased by 20%, Cryo : CRIT DMG is increased by 20%. . Additionally, when Dendro Cores (including Bountiful Cores, Seeds of Deceit) appear nearby on the field, or when the party obtains Verdant Dew, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis. These two methods can each grant the Traveler up to 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis every 4s, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis and transform into the special Charged Attack: Verdessence . Charged Attack: Verdessence Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Dendro DMG . The increase in DMG is equal to 80% of Traveler's ATK. c1.name: Symbiotic Creeper
c1.effect: After Razorgrass Blade hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

c2.name: Green Resilience
c2.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Lea Lotus Lamp 's duration is increased by 3s. The Lea Lotus Lamp's duration is increased to 15 seconds. The Lea Lotus Lamp in its original state or after Hydro transformation now hit the enemies a total of 10 times. The Lea Lotus Lamp after Electro transformation now hit the enemies a total of 16 times.

c3.name: Whirling Weeds
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Razorgrass Blade by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Treacle Grass
c4.effect: After the Lea Lotus Lamp triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Ascension Talent " Verdant Overgrowth ." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."

c5.name: Viridian Transience
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Surgent Manifestation by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Withering Aggregation
c6.effect: The Dendro DMG Bonus of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the Lea Lotus Lamp is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.
